tools.name: search_colleges
tools.description: Find a campus id by school name (e.g. "Ohio State" → osu.edu). Campuses with listings come first, with propertyCount. Required before searching addresses.

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: List rental addresses near a campus, filtered by street or house number text. Returns grade (null if unreviewed), review count and record counts.

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Everything on file for one address: grade, safety flags, every public record with its source, tenant-reported landlords, aggregate tenant answers, plus the verified reviews.

tools.name: search_owners
tools.description: Find registered owners / contacts from city rental registries by name; returns how many licensed properties each holds near which campus and the page listing them.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_colleges" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find a campus id by school name (e.g. "Ohio State" → osu.edu). Required before searching addresses." → after: "Find a campus id by school name (e.g. "Ohio State" → osu.edu). Campuses with listings come first, with propertyCount. Required before searching addresses."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
